title: Read a call with of, at, from and to
objective: Use the small words of, at, from and to between the values of a call, so the call reads like a sentence.

body.text: A call can put one of the words of, at, from or to in front of a value. The word belongs to the sentence, so the call reads more naturally. The values still go to the parameters in order, so the words do not change which parameter gets which value.

body.title: Distance from a start to an end
body.code:
function distance
    takes number called start
    takes number called end
    gives back end minus start

say distance from 3 to 10

body.text: at works the same way. This call writes a text value into a file. The first value is the content, and the value after at is the path.

body.title: Write at a path
body.code:
function write
    takes text called content
    takes text called path
    say "{path}: {content}"

write "hi" at "log.txt"

body.text: of works with one value. A function that takes one number can be called with of, which reads like a question about that number.

body.title: One value with of
body.code:
function double
    takes number called n
    gives back n times 2

say double of 4

body.prompt: The write call is missing its path, so the program does not compile. Make it print notes.txt: hi.
body.starter:
function write
    takes text called content
    takes text called path
    say "{path}: {content}"

write "hi"
body.solution:
function write
    takes text called content
    takes text called path
    say "{path}: {content}"

write "hi" at "notes.txt"
